title: Ajanta’s later painted caves are excavated
summary: A later phase of work at Ajanta added richly decorated Buddhist caves. Paintings and sculptures accompanied new sanctuaries and monastic spaces after a long interruption in excavation activity.

claims.text: A later phase of work at Ajanta added richly decorated Buddhist caves. Paintings and sculptures accompanied new sanctuaries and monastic spaces after a long interruption in excavation activity.
Fifth–sixth centuries CE; attributed by the synthesis to Vakataka-period patronage.

The gap between construction phases matters when comparing artistic styles or patronage. The later caves are not evidence that one workshop or political regime operated continuously across the entire site history.
